function: Joint NOMA power allocation on idle subchannels and IRS phase control by a feasibility-preserving TD3 actor, maximizing sum rate with outage and delay penalties (p. 6, p. 8)
system: SBS and 40 SUs all single-antenna, 10 subchannels x 4 NOMA users; passive reflecting IRS, 64 elements; 100 MHz bandwidth, no carrier frequency stated (p. 4, p. 7)
method: TD3 actor-critic reinforcement learning with feasibility-preserving output mapping, heuristic-seeded residual IRS phases, projected phase refinement and candidate-selection shield; trained offline, MLP(128,128) (p. 8, p. 10, p. 15)
data_channel: Custom Monte Carlo simulator: Rayleigh direct links, Rician-factor-0 (Rayleigh) IRS hops, pathloss exponent 3, random SU positions, perfect instantaneous CSI; no dataset or measurement (p. 4, p. 11)
test_conditions: Trained with SNR in 0-30 dB, fixed topology; tested over SNR 0-20 dB with 600 fading blocks; no other geometry, user count or IRS size reported (p. 7, p. 11)
baselines: Learned: TD3+Proj, DDPG+Proj, penalty-only TD3; FP-TD3 ablations. Non-learned: PSO, GA, equal and random power, weakest-user heuristic phase (p. 11)
metrics: Average sum rate, energy efficiency, runtime per allocation, hard-constraint violation rate, outage and delay violation rates, training convergence (p. 11, p. 12, p. 14)
complexity: Per-block order O(C_pi+MN+N log(range/nu)+T_ref(C_theta+MN)+(T_ref+2)MN); actor 0.862 M parameters (3.45 MB); under 1 ms per allocation; training about 21 min on GPU (p. 10, p. 15)
q1_support: p. 11: "The direct links follow Rayleigh" - custom Rayleigh and Rician-abstraction simulator (also p. 4); no 3GPP model, public ray-tracing dataset or measured channel is used.
q2_support: p. 11: "We vary the SNR over" - testing sweeps SNR 0-20 dB on fresh blocks of the same topology and fading law used in training; no new scenario, user count, IRS size or band is tested.
q3_support: p. 11: "Joint TD3+Proj and DDPG+Proj" (learned baselines) and p. 11: "PSO and GA with heuristic phase" (non-learned), compared on sum rate and energy efficiency in Fig. 3 (p. 12).
q4_support: p. 15: "0.862 M parameters (3.45 MB in FP32)" - actor size; Section VI (p. 10) gives the per-block complexity order, and p. 15 gives under 1 ms per allocation and 21 min training.
q5_support: p. 10: "through Monte Carlo simulation" - data come from the authors' own simulator; no code or data link, DOI or public dataset is given anywhere in the 17 pages.
notes: Area 3: the learned function is IRS phase control (RIS configuration) jointly with NOMA power; SBS and SUs are single-antenna so there is no precoder, but the IRS keeps the system check satisfied. Penalty-only TD3 is a variant of the proposed method and is not counted as a learned baseline; q3 rests on DDPG+Proj, a standard algorithm applied to the same problem (TD3+Proj is close to an ablation of FP-TD3). Perfect instantaneous CSI is assumed (p. 4). Table 3 was read from the page image (p. 7).
